Stream2D Live video

Stream2D Based on WebRTC Real time 2D Video capability.SDK Output camera H264 The flow of codes passes to business echoes, without decoding or recoding.fps Default value is 60and pass it to the camera as a video session parameter;SDK Do not limit, delay, or discard the receiving frame by that value. fps Do not change the output speed; the parameter is applied by the camera in hard-trigger mode.

Positioning: Passage, no decoding

Camera pass. WebRTC Output H264 The flow.SDK Completed RTP Restructure and hand it to the side of the business as a coding frame. The coding frame can be used to decode the rendering and save as .h264 Or forward it to follow-up.
Camera Capability Requirements

Only support Stream2D . If the capability is not supported, the stream may fail or remain unframed; this means the current camera cannot be opened Stream2D, does not mean SDK Yeah. H264 The data was misprocessed.

Recommended use: Trusteeship session

The Trusteeship Session Envelope Consultation, Connection Management and Frame Relays are applicable to the regular reception process.

Once. StartStream2DRtcSession Only create peer. Corresponds StopStream2DRtcSession Just stop it. peer; The other receiving end on the same camera is not affected.StopAll All incoming sessions on your device are used to stop, not for normal sessions to exit.

Python

import asyncio
from epiceye.stream2d import start_stream2d_rtc_session, stop_stream2d_rtc_session

async def main():
    session = await start_stream2d_rtc_session(
        ip="127.0.0.1:5000",
        fps=60,
        camera_index=0,
    )
    try:
        await asyncio.sleep(10)
    finally:
        await stop_stream2d_rtc_session(session)
    print("Number of frames received:", session.result.frame_count)

asyncio.run(main())

Only accept encoding frames

When you use a hosting session, video start-up and frame reception are managed by the same session without the need for a separate call to the bottom start-up interface.
